stem:
Meena stands in front of three different mirrors at a science mela in her school. In mirror 1, her image is erect and the same size as her. In mirror 2, when she stands very close, her image is erect and enlarged. In mirror 3, her image is always erect and smaller than her.
Which row correctly names the three mirrors?

options.text: Mirror 1: concave, Mirror 2: plane, Mirror 3: convex
Mirror 1: plane, Mirror 2: concave, Mirror 3: convex
Mirror 1: plane, Mirror 2: convex, Mirror 3: concave
Mirror 1: convex, Mirror 2: concave, Mirror 3: plane

teacher.key_rationale: A plane mirror gives an erect, same-size image (mirror 1). A concave mirror gives an erect, enlarged image when the object is very close (mirror 2). A convex mirror always gives an erect, diminished image (mirror 3). Only option B matches all three observations.
